entities.name: IMEISV request
entities.description: An information element that the MME may include to request the UE to send its IMEISV with the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: A NAS message sent by the UE to complete the security mode command procedure.

entities.name: IMEISV
entities.description: The International Mobile Equipment Identity and Software Version number of the UE.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity that may include the IMEISV request IE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that may send its IMEISV in response to the IMEISV request.

relations.description: The SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message may contain the IMEISV IE when requested.
The MME may include the IMEISV request IE to trigger the UE to send its IMEISV.
The IMEISV request IE establishes that the UE should send its IMEISV in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
